# Appsolutely Free

> Appsolutely Free (https://appsolutelyfree.com/) is a human-curated directory of 260+ free and open-source software (FOSS) alternatives to 74 expensive paid subscriptions across 12 software categories. Every alternative is audited for zero adware, active maintenance, and transparent licensing.

## Overview
- **Mission**: Digital sovereignty and budget independence. "Your budget shouldn't decide whether you get to start."
- **Founder**: Yishay Stewart-Mitchell (Jamaica, Queens, New York).
- **Core Tiers**: $0 to use (100% free), Limited free plan (generous free tier), Requires hosting/hardware (self-hostable open source).
- **Full Text Catalog**: https://appsolutelyfree.com/llms-full.txt
- **Machine-Readable JSON API**: https://appsolutelyfree.com/data.json
- **Sitemap**: https://appsolutelyfree.com/sitemap.xml

## Software Categories
- [Design & Illustration](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/design/): Free software alternatives for Free alternatives to Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma.
- [Photo Editing](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/photo/): Free software alternatives for RAW processing and photo workflows without a subscription.
- [Video & Animation](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/video/): Free software alternatives for Edit, composite, and record video for free.
- [Audio & Music](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/audio/): Free software alternatives for Record, mix, and compose with open-source studios.
- [Office & Documents](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/office/): Free software alternatives for Documents, PDFs, diagrams, and email without Microsoft 365.
- [Notes & Productivity](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/productivity/): Free software alternatives for Notes, tasks, budgeting, and scheduling you control.
- [Chat & Meetings](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/communication/): Free software alternatives for Team chat and video calls without per-seat pricing.
- [Security & Privacy](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/security/): Free software alternatives for Password managers, 2FA apps, and private VPNs.
- [Cloud & Storage](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/cloud/): Free software alternatives for Sync files and photos on your terms.
- [Media & Streaming](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/media/): Free software alternatives for Music, podcasts, audiobooks, and media servers.
- [Developer Tools](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/dev/): Free software alternatives for Editors, API clients, and backends you can own.
- [3D & CAD](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/3d-cad/): Free software alternatives for Model, design, and engineer without a license fee.
- [Business & Analytics](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/business/): Free software alternatives for Analytics, dashboards, email, and automation.
- [System Utilities](https://appsolutelyfree.com/category/utilities/): Free software alternatives for Archivers, VMs, remote desktop, and cleanup tools.

## Educational Resources & Guides
- [Software Switching Guides](https://appsolutelyfree.com/guides/): Migration roadmaps, file compatibility (PSD, DOCX, XLSX, DWG), and gotchas before cancelling subscriptions.
- [Free Learning & Practice Labs](https://appsolutelyfree.com/learning/): Free official tutorials, interactive practice labs, and full curricula.
- [Free Creative Resources](https://appsolutelyfree.com/resources/): Free fonts, icons, sound effects, textures, and UI kits.
- [Free & Open-Source Games](https://appsolutelyfree.com/games/): Fair-play open-source games and giveaway trackers.
- [Annual Savings Calculator](https://appsolutelyfree.com/#calculatorSection): Calculate personal or business savings by replacing commercial software.
